q.line: Whereupon I wrested from your godawful lawlessness
stanza: Say, honey, did you belong to me?
Tell me, honey, did I pass your test?
I lay as still as death until the dawn
Whereupon I wrested from your godawful lawlessness

partner.line: I lay as still as death until the dawn

stanza: I feel you, leaning out back with the crickets
Loyal heart marking the soon-ness, darkness
Tonight, still the mourning doves will summon us their song

partner.line: Tonight, still the mourning doves will summon us their song
